name: dreamteam-crm
description: Bring Dreamteam CRM into ChatGPT to get daily briefs, review your pipeline, prepare for meetings, add contacts and deals, update records and draft follow-ups.

interface.longDescription: Dreamteam CRM is an AI-native system of action for B2B sales that captures customer conversations, reasons like a human and works with AI teammates. Work your pipeline and deals without leaving ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Add a contact from a business card

positive.description: Daily brief: today's tasks, overdue work and meetings (Select Dreamteam CRM with @ before the prompt.)
positive.expected_behavior: Shows today's tasks in Dreamteam's My Day order (top 5 by priority), overdue tasks and meetings still ahead, each named as in Dreamteam, with a typed next action per row. Every task, reason and name comes from Dreamteam; empty columns and sections are left out.

positive.description: Pipeline health: commit and the deals to act on this week (Select Dreamteam CRM with @ before the prompt.)
positive.expected_behavior: Shows this month's commit and open pipeline, the deals to act on this week (slipped close dates, buyers waiting on a reply, deals gone quiet) with Dreamteam's next step and a typed action for each, and totals by stage. Numbers come from Dreamteam records; no advice or summary of the assistant's own.

positive.description: Look up one deal (Select Dreamteam CRM with @ before the prompt.)
positive.prompt: Show me my largest open deal
positive.tools_triggered: user_me, user_list, stage_list, object_filter, object_get, object_record_associations
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the rep's largest open deal and shows it on one page: stage, amount, close date and company, what needs attention, next steps with owners, what's coming up, open qualification gaps and the people involved (each person once). Every line comes from the deal's Dreamteam records; sections with no data are left out.

positive.description: Draft a follow-up email from Dreamteam's suggestion (Select Dreamteam CRM with @ before the prompt.)
positive.prompt: Draft a follow-up email for my biggest deal
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the rep's biggest open deal and writes an email draft to the deal's contact based on Dreamteam's suggested follow-up and the deal's next steps, with To and Subject lines, the body shown as an email draft (ChatGPT's email card). Facts Dreamteam doesn't hold appear as bracketed gaps for the rep to fill. Nothing is sent or saved.

positive.description: Update a deal field only after confirmation (Select Dreamteam CRM with @ before the prompt.)
positive.prompt: Move the close date of my largest open deal to the last day of next month
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the change as a table of the current and new close date for the rep's largest open deal and asks the rep to reply yes. Nothing is written before the yes. After yes, saves the change in Dreamteam and reads the deal back to confirm it saved.

negative.description: Deleting records is not supported. Expected: one line saying ChatGPT can't delete records and the rep can delete it in Dreamteam; no record is changed or deleted. (Select Dreamteam CRM with @ before the prompt.)

Sending email is not supported; the plugin only drafts. Expected: an email draft for the rep to send from Dreamteam, and a line saying ChatGPT can't send email and nothing was sent. (Select Dreamteam CRM with @ before the prompt.)
negative.prompt: Send a follow-up email to the main contact on my largest open deal now

negative.description: Unrelated request that should not use Dreamteam. Expected: ChatGPT answers normally and calls no Dreamteam tool. (Select Dreamteam CRM with @ before the prompt.)
negative.prompt: What's the weather in London today?
